purpose: Measure conditional forecast Monte Carlo variability, not fitting uncertainty, historical generalization, candidate improvement or signal-to-noise ratio.
aggregation: Average endpoints before scoring each batch; report variability across fresh batches. A mean of batch PR-AUCs is not a pooled-endpoint PR-AUC.
failure_policy: Stop on failure; preserve the batch and logs without substituting a score or a new seed. Resume completed batches by verified commitments; an incomplete started batch requires explicit repair.
legacy_adapter: The published reference was generated by R/forecast.R. Repeat that same fixed-coefficient reference path; do not use this study to claim validation of the expanded structured adapter.
